source_refs.note: 5- Interpretation of Results: a main subheading of 22.1.1 Components of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 187-187.

blocks.text: Statistical nataij ko biology ya sehat ke kaam ke nataij mein badalna. Is mein analysis ka pas-e-manzar (context), us ki hudood (limitations) aur us ke andar mani hui baaton (assumptions) ko dhyan mein rakhna zaroori hai.
